blocks.text: Custom tags are key-value pairs that allow you to organize, identify, and distinguish the resources created and deployed by DSPM in your cloud environment. Custom tags are created and applied to the DSPM resources while deploying the templates.
You can add, edit, or delete the custom tags, as required.
You must be assigned either an Administrator role or a custom role with the Configure Monitoring Scope permission in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Custom tags must match the syntax used by cloud service providers to prevent errors while reading the tags. Follow these guidelines while adding custom tags:

blocks.item: Custom tags can start with any supported character, including lowercase letters, uppercase letters, numbers, spaces, or special characters (+ = @ _ / : . -).
Custom tags shouldn't start with aws.
Keys must have a minimum of 1 character and not exceed 127 characters, and values must not exceed 256 characters.
The values field can be empty.
Keys can include lowercase letters, uppercase letters, numbers, spaces, or special characters (! @ # ^ * () _ {} : ; ' | . , [] ` ~ + = @ _ -).
Keys must have a minimum of 1 character and not exceed 128 characters.
Values can include lowercase letters, uppercase letters, numbers, spaces, or special characters (% & ? / > <)
Keys and values must include only lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters (_ or -).
Keys must start with a lowercase letter.
Keys must have a minimum of 1 character and not exceed 63 characters.
The values field can be empty.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Click Manage, and then select Manage Custom Tags from the drop-down menu.
The Manage Custom Tags page appears.
On the Manage Custom Tags page, enter the key and value for the tag.
Click Add More, and enter key-value pairs to add more tags.
On the Apply Changes page, download and deploy the template.
You can see the number of custom tags added on the Overview page.

blocks.text: When you modify a custom tag and deploy the templates, the new custom tag overrides the existing custom tag, and the resources are updated with the modified tags.

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Click Manage, and then select Manage Custom Tags from the drop-down menu.
The Manage Custom Tags page appears.
On the Manage Custom Tags page, modify the key and value for the required tag.
On the Apply Changes page, download and deploy the templates.

blocks.text: When you delete custom tags, the tags are removed from the resources after you deploy the templates.

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Click Manage, and then select Manage Custom Tags from the drop-down menu.
The Manage Custom Tags page appears.
On the Manage Custom Tags page, click the Close icon for the custom tag that you want to delete.
On the Apply Changes page, download and deploy the templates.
